title: Undercurrents Surging
next_chapter_hook: Three days. Chen Ji must make a choice—whether to face the imperial envoy's blade or voluntarily abandon his title as Grand Preceptor to the Crown Prince. And that presence watching from the shadows waits to crush him utterly.

text.content: When Chen Ji opened his eyes, he sensed a gaze—not from the Tianji Eye, but from something far higher. Mo Xiansheng's warning echoed in his ears: "It has awakened." The gaze was cold, ancient, as if existing since time immemorial. It wasn't targeting Chen Ji's physical form, but piercing through his soul, examining him like an insignificant piece on a chessboard. "Awakened..." Chen Ji repeated quietly, his fingertips trembling slightly. The weight of these three words far exceeded what anyone could imagine. The Heavenly Secrets Eye was not an end, but a tentacle of a higher existence—so what, then, was this existence?

Chen Ji forced down the chill in his heart, pulling his consciousness back from the depths of that幽深 darkness. He found himself still sitting cross-legged before the Tianji Record Fragment, surrounded by that诡异 void. Yet in the next instant, he sensed something amiss. From the direction of the imperial capital, the Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently, sending waves of heart-stopping fluctuation. This was not ordinary spiritual energy, but—national fortune. The dragon vein qi accumulated over hundreds of years by the Daqi Imperial Dynasty was宣泄ing失控ly. The Grand Preceptor's mansion had encountered trouble.

Beyond the Tianqing Sect, the imperial envoys' procession pressed forward like gathering storm clouds. The lead figure wore a black official robe, a sword of the Son of Heaven at his waist, his face cold as iron. Behind him came thirty-six golden-armored guards, each with cultivation no lower than late Foundation Building—this was the Xuantie Guard, the imperial dynasty's special force for dealing with "rebels". "By imperial decree—" The envoy unfurled the bright yellow edict, his voice carrying through the surroundings with spiritual energy augmentation, "Grand Preceptor to the Crown Prince Chen Ji, for privately consorting with the Demonic Path and intent to rebel, is ordered to present himself at the imperial capital within three days to give account. Failure to appear by the deadline shall be considered treason, with entire family executed."

A commotion erupted among the watching crowd. "Grand Preceptor? Isn't that just a servant disciple from the Tianqing Sect?" "I heard he managed to latch onto the Crown Prince,没想到这么快就要倒了." "Three days? Heh, he probably won't even make it to the road." And at the edge of the crowd, a figure stood like a straight spear. Han Lie, the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect, had a playful curve at the corner of his mouth, as if watching a drama with a predetermined ending.

dialogue.content: "Three days?" Han Lie sneered, his voice soft but precisely carrying to everyone's ears, "These old foxes of the imperial court probably overestimated that waste's hardiness. Chen Ji ah Chen Ji, did you think latching onto the Crown Prince meant eternal security?" He stepped forward, golden battle intent swirling around him, "This young lord has been waiting for this day for a very long time."

text.content: Meanwhile, in another corner of the imperial capital. A slender figure stood within the shadows—none other than the Demonic Path Holy Maiden Ye Qing. Her face no longer held its usual composure, replaced by an extremely complex expression. "Chen Ji... I'm sorry." Her voice was as low as a mosquito's whine, then turned ice-cold, "But this is for... a larger game."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji sensed the dramatic changes in the outside world while in the void, and he had to make a decision immediately. Facing the imperial dynasty's final ultimatum and the hostility lurking in shadows, how would he respond to this crisis?

choices.description: Respond to the imperial envoys directly as Grand Preceptor to the Crown Prince, displaying a strong stance, never showing weakness.
choices.risk_hint: May expose some abilities of the Tianji Record

text.content: The moment Chen Ji returned to his physical body from the void, a cold smile curled at his lips. "Grand Preceptor to the Crown Prince Chen Ji respectfully receives the imperial decree." His voice was calm as water, yet carried an unsettling composure. This serenity caused the originally arrogant imperial envoy to feel an inexplicable unease.

choices.description: Do not confront the imperial dynasty directly, first use the Tianji Record to investigate the mastermind before making a decision.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily relinquish the conveniences brought by the Grand Preceptor title
choices.risk_hint: May be misinterpreted as fleeing from guilt

text.content: Chen Ji silently retreated into the depths of the crowd,收敛his aura to the extreme. Since the other party wanted to play, he would accompany them to the end. Three days was enough time for him to gauge how deep these waters ran. "The imperial envoys?" His voice emerged from the shadows, ice-cold and mocking, "Not so fast."

choices.description: Use intelligence about Ye Qing's betrayal to set up a reverse scheme, eliminating all enemies in one fell swoop.
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing is being manipulated by a higher existence behind her, there may be backlash

text.content: A flash of light passed through Chen Ji's eyes, and he already had a plan. Ye Qing's betrayal? Perhaps not genuine. But he noticed the struggle in Ye Qing's eyes—that was a sign of being controlled. "What a grand performance." He murmured softly, "Let me see just how far you intend to take this play."

Just as everyone buzzed with discussion, a sharp sword intent erupted toward the heavens. Han Lie made his move. His figure was like lightning, instantly closing in on the Grand Preceptor's mansion gates, throwing a punch—the Xuanwu Sect's ultimate technique "Xuanwu True Intent," capable of shattering half the Tianqing Sect. "Chen Ji! Get out here!" His roar shook the ancient trees before the sect gate, "Today, I will show the world who the realtrashis!"

dialogue.content: "Last time at the Forbidden Grounds, you barely escaped." Han Lie pressed forward step by step, each step cracking the ground, "This time, young lord wants to see what other tricks you have!" His eyes burned with obsessive rage. This man called "waste" had become the greatest demon blocking his martial path.

text.content: However, in the next instant, a black mist spread silently. The Demonic Path Holy Maiden Ye Qing made her move. Her "Demonic Path Miasma" was an excellent means of concealing aura, yet now it enveloped Han Lie. "Han Lie, you have overstepped." Ye Qing's voice was cold as frost, "Chen Ji is my... partner."

choice.prompt: Ye Qing suddenly came to his aid, but Chen Ji knows she has already betrayed him. At this moment, how would he choose?

choices.description: Pretend ignorance of Ye Qing's betrayal, join forces with her to repel Han Lie, secretly seeking the truth.
choices.visible_cost: May cause Ye Qing to lower her guard even further
choices.visible_reward: Buy time to investigate the mastermind behind the scenes
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may turn against him at a critical moment

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stepped out from the shadows, a faint, composed smile appearing on his face. "What Lady Ye Qing said is correct." He stood with hands behind his back, his gaze falling on Han Lie, "Young Master Han, why such haste? The accounts between us will be settled eventually."

choices.description: Publicly expose Ye Qing's betrayal, catching her completely off guard.
choices.visible_reward: May force the forces behind Ye Qing to reveal themselves
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may resort to desperate measures

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze was blazing, piercing directly toward Ye Qing. "Partner?" His voice turned ice-cold abruptly, "Lady Ye Qing, did the 'master' behind you ever tell you how to betray me?"

choices.description: Make no statement, watch the contest between Ye Qing and Han Lie, waiting for the optimal moment to act.
choices.visible_reward: Observe various reactions, gather more intelligence
choices.risk_hint: May miss the opportunity to seize initiative

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back, watching this scene with great interest. The Demonic Path Holy Maiden versus the Xuanwu Sect genius? Interesting. When these two seemingly antagonistic people clashed, what secrets lay hidden behind? He suddenly realized this chess game was far more complex than he imagined.

Han Lie, enveloped by the Demonic Path Miasma, erupted with fury. "Demonic path witch!" Golden light blazed around him, Xuanwu True Intent manifesting as a massive Black Tortoise phantom, forcibly tearing through the black mist, "You, like thattrash, are all people who deserve death!" However, in that flash of lightning, Ye Qing's expression suddenly changed—that was not anger, but a fear rooted in her bones.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji caught that fleeting fear, his heart stirring. He followed Ye Qing's gaze—deep in the horizon, a faint rune was slowly emerging. The shape of that rune bore a striking resemblance to the patterns on the Tianji Record Fragment. "It's watching us." Ye Qing's voice dropped to a near whisper, trembling slightly, "Chen Ji, that is... the true master of the Heavenly Secrets Eye."

text.content: The true master of the Heavenly Secrets Eye. These six words were like a basin of ice water, extinguishing the last shred of Chen Ji's wishful thinking. He finally understood—Ye Qing's betrayal was not of her own will—she was being controlled, and the one controlling her was that existence beyond the Tianji Record. "I've noted it." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, "When the time comes, I will make you all pay the price."

In the distance, the imperial envoy's gaze pierced through the crowd, meeting Chen Ji's eyes exactly. In that instant, Chen Ji sensed a familiar aura—that was the aura of Former Sect Master Ling Yuan. So that's how it was. The imperial envoys, Ling Yuan, that higher existence... this game of chess was far grander than Chen Ji had imagined. And he was merely a piece pushed onto the board. But pieces have their uses too.

Night wind howled, disheveling Chen Ji's robes. He turned and vanished into the depths of the crowd, leaving behind a softly spoken remark: "Three days? Enough." Enough for him to turn the clouds and覆雨, enough to crush all his enemies into dust. Han Lie gazed at that disappearing figure, and for the first time felt a strange chill. Ye Qing, however, bit her lip hard, her fingertips already seeping blood. This night was destined to be sleepless.
